blocks.html: ROBINSONS HOTELS AND RESORTS PARTNERS WITH CARITAS MANILA
Go Hotels and Summit Hotels and Resorts are proud to commit their support to Caritas Manila’s Youth Leadership &amp; Education Program (YSLEP).
YSLEP provides financial and scholastic assistance to scholars and trains and hones the youth to be exemplary in academic, social and spiritual aspects.

YSLEP is sustained through various activities, one of them being Segunda Mana, the donations-in-kind program of Caritas Manila. Proceeds from Segunda Mana are channeled to YSLEP to provide further financial assistance to their students.
Through Segunda Mana, hotel items from the different branches of Go Hotels and Summit Hotels and Resorts will be donated to fund the YSLEP.

"We are happy to partner with Caritas Manila and be able to support its YSELP,” shares Robinsons Hotels and Resorts’ General Manager, Elizabeth Gregorio. “In our own small way, we are able to open opportunities and make life more pleasant for others. This adds meaning to the work we do."
Caritas Manila is the social services and development ministry of the Archdiocese of Manila chaired by Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle.
Go Hotels and Summit Hotels and Resorts are part of Robinsons Hotels and Resorts, a division of Robinsons Land Corporation.
